domain.inputs: Fixed attached unshared non-resizable ArrayBuffer or ArrayBufferView byte window; Buffer/typed array/DataView use exact byteOffset and byteLength. No string conversion. Arbitrary Proxy/reflection behavior is outside ordinary-input contract.
domain.options: undefined or ordinary Object.prototype/null-prototype record containing only own data maxOutputLength; undefined value means default; integer 1..16777216; no symbols, accessors, foreign prototypes or other option keys.
domain.codec: Selected defaults only; exactly one zlib/gzip/raw stream/member; no trailing bytes or preset dictionary; six synchronous calls only.
domain.deferred: Other 31 callables explicitly refuse call/new; implemented six refuse new; no async, streaming, auto-detect, Brotli or CRC32 support.
domain.ownership: Input copied/staged in native storage; native output copied to fresh JS-owned Uint8Array, then exposed as Buffer view; no partial output on failure. Logical caps are not process or peak-memory limits.
domain.namespace: Finite 40 bindings; canonical/bare aliases and supported literal CJS use existing selected-module mechanism. Frozen default/constants/codes differs from Node mutability; no universal dynamic-import/require promise.

groups.proposal: Node has no errno; current native error has own numeric errno=1. A separately reviewed change could omit errno for ERR_BUFFER_TOO_LARGE while retaining genuine codec errno on codec failures. This contract changes no runtime or validation expectation.
Reject decoded output above 16777216 bytes even where Node succeeds. Current own errno=1 remains explicitly recorded; no byte or outcome parity claim.

Require one complete format-selected stream/member and exact compressed input consumption; refuse a second member or trailing bytes. Node gzip-multi returns 512 bytes; other five observed multi/trailing cases return 256 bytes. Do not infer uniform Node concatenation.
Dictionary support is unavailable; preserve explicit ERR_SM_ZLIB_DICTIONARY_UNSUPPORTED versus Node Z_NEED_DICT. Both recorded errno values are 2.
Enforce 1048576 input-window bytes before codec work. This changes error precedence for malformed oversized input and refuses oversized valid input accepted by Node.

Current maxOutputLength must be an integer; Node accepts 1.5 far enough to produce ERR_BUFFER_TOO_LARGE. Explicitly decide whether to retain strict integer refusal or implement Node validation/error semantics in a new version. No decision is issued here.
Reject maxOutputLength above 16777216 even when actual output would fit. This option-domain limit is separate from actual produced-output size.
Only maxOutputLength is admitted. Preserve level-option refusal and do not claim Node configurable-compression behavior.
Refuse strings; no encoding conversion. Only fixed attached unshared ArrayBuffer and ArrayBufferView windows are in the finite domain.

comparisonBoundary.successfulByteComparisons: Prior normal review checks full decoded bytes for 138 successful observations; not a new codec run or all-Node-zlib claim.

constantDeviation.name: ZLIB_VERNUM
constantDeviation.rule: Expose actual selected header number only after source verify_backend compares linked zlibVersion() to header ZLIB_VERSION. Public value plus guarded initialization gives source-coupled inference; it does not return a private linked version string or rewrite historical metadata. Never substitute Node 4865.
